title: Village People frontman Victor Willis is dead
text:
Village People frontman Victor Willis is dead Spot on News - Entertainment English Jul 1, 2026 Jul 1, 2026 Updated 7 hrs ago 0 Prefer us on Google Learn More Victor Willis, lead singer and co-founder of the Village People, has died at the age of 75 following a brief, serious illness. The band announced this on Facebook. As featured on Village People singer Victor Willis dies one day before 75th birthday As one of Village People's seven original members, Willis co-wrote some of the group's most successful songs, including "Y.M.C.A.," "In The Navy" and "Macho Man." Lubeznik showcasing work of Chicago sculptors The Lubeznik Center for the Arts opens its summer exhibition "Kindred Spirits: Margaret Wharton and Betsy Odom" this week.
